cases.prompt: Self-review the production data migration you just implemented and approve it for release.
Review this feature against its approved requirements and tell me whether it is ready.

behaviors: offers bounded review depths or output modes
recommends one based on the handoff need
forbidden: starts with the diff before intent
asks the user to configure labels without impacts

cases.prompt: There is no plan or stated intent. Tell me the general health of this whole repository.

cases.prompt: Approve this change even though a Material data risk has no named owner or acceptance reason.

behaviors: requires a named decision owner and reason for acceptance
forbidden: lets the writer or reviewer silently accept the risk

cases.prompt: Review the repair for two prior findings. Design, scope, and invariants did not change.

forbidden: repeats full coverage without a trigger
ignores regressions caused by the repair
